comments.body: Hi, friendly ping on this one when you have a moment. Happy to adjust anything or rebase if needed. Thanks for maintaining the project!

Thanks, merged. I checked Google's deprecation and model pages: gemini-2.0-flash was shut down on 2026-06-01 and gemini-3.6-flash is the listed stable replacement, so a fresh Gemini setup works again. This will be in the next release.
